idea-plugin.name: CLI Shortcut
idea-plugin.description:
English

CLI Shortcut is a lightweight IntelliJ IDEA plugin for running frequently used command-line scripts directly from the IDE toolbar. It is designed for developers who repeatedly open Terminal and type the same project commands, such as starting local services, running build scripts, executing deployment helpers, refreshing generated files, or launching other CLI workflows.

After installation, the plugin adds a fixed toolbar button to the top-right area of the IDE. Clicking the button opens or focuses the built-in IDEA Terminal, sends a greeting command first, and then runs the enabled scripts configured by the user. Scripts are executed in the order shown in the settings page, with disabled or blank scripts skipped.

Configuration is available under Settings | Tools | CLI Shortcut. The settings page supports multiple scripts and lets you enable or disable each script, edit its display name, edit the command content, add or remove scripts, and move scripts up or down to control execution order. The default configuration includes an explanatory echo script so users can immediately see how the plugin works after installation.

This plugin intentionally keeps the workflow simple: it acts as a CLI shortcut launcher inside the IDE. It does not parse command output, manage background jobs, or replace Terminal. The terminal remains visible so users can inspect output, errors, prompts, and shell behavior exactly as they would during normal command-line work.

中文

CLI Shortcut 是一个轻量级 IntelliJ IDEA 插件，用来从 IDE 工具栏快速执行常用命令行脚本。 它适合经常需要打开 Terminal 并重复输入相同项目命令的开发场景，例如启动本地服务、运行构建脚本、 执行部署辅助命令、刷新生成文件，或触发其他 CLI 工作流。

插件安装后，会在 IDEA 右上角工具栏添加一个固定按钮。点击按钮后，插件会打开或聚焦 IDEA 内置 Terminal， 先发送一条问候命令，然后继续按用户配置执行已启用脚本。脚本会按照设置页中的顺序执行，未启用或内容为空的脚本会被跳过。

配置入口位于 Settings | Tools | CLI Shortcut。设置页支持配置多个脚本，可以启用或停用单个脚本、 编辑脚本显示名称、编辑命令内容、新增或删除脚本，并通过上移、下移调整执行顺序。默认配置包含一个说明用 echo 脚本， 用户安装后可以立刻看到插件的执行效果。

这个插件刻意保持简单：它只是 IDE 内的 CLI 快捷启动器，不解析命令输出，不管理后台任务，也不替代 Terminal。 终端会保持可见，用户可以像平常使用命令行一样查看输出、错误、提示符和 shell 行为。
